get_monster.description: One monster's entry in the bestiary: combat level, life points, weakness, combat stats, the experience a kill gives, its Slayer category and the level needed, where it is found, and whether it is aggressive, poisonous or members only. Takes a name or an id; a name with no monster comes back marked not found rather than failing.

parameters.name: monster

Profiles are private unless the player opts in; a private one comes back marked unavailable with the reason rather than failing.

description: Read RuneScape's own public data: Grand Exchange prices and price history, the hiscores, clans, RuneMetrics profiles and quest logs, the bestiary and the live player count, from the endpoints Jagex publishes for the game. Price any item by name, chart how it has moved, read a player's every skill and activity, see who leads a skill, list a clan's members, follow a player's adventurer's log, look up a monster's weakness, or post how many people are online. No account or API key is required.
